name: acp_chat_start
description: Start a persistent chat session with the external ACP agent (for example kiro-cli). Returns a chatId you pass to acp_chat_send. The conversation context usually survives between messages, process release, and host restarts; if the agent lost the session, the next acp_chat_send says so.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory for the chat session (the agent works here).

label.description: Optional short name for the chat (at most 80 characters), shown by acp_chat_list so you can tell chats apart later.
